summary:
Revised implementation plan for Zayed SalesForce finalization:
- Multi-mode commission system (fixed flat amount per order AND percentage-based %)
- 24-hour expiring temporary password flow for Forgot Password recovery with mandatory first-login password change
- APK (<5MB) & installed size (<20MB) optimization via native Compose Canvas, unused dependency pruning, and resource hygiene
- Interactive Canvas Admin sales charts (7-day trend, hourly timeline, revenue vs volume) & 3-layer low-stock alert system
- Executive and individual Sales Rep KPI dashboards with branded downloadable commission slips
- Stealth Admin Auth with secondary PIN layer and complete staff lifecycle governance (reset, change PIN, suspend, terminate, delete)
- Customer profile archival and restoration
